ayuda: Tap the bubble, ask your question and tap again to send it.
etiqueta.ia: Answer generated by local AI. Not a diagnosis; the level is computed by the system rules.
etiqueta.reglas: Answer built from local rules, no generative AI. Not a diagnosis.
error.sinMicrofono: This browser cannot use the microphone. Open the app from localhost or over HTTPS.
error.permiso: Microphone permission is missing. Enable it in the browser and try again.
error.vacio: Nothing was heard. Record a little longer.
error.desactivada: Local voice is disabled. Set ORBIT_VOZ_ACTIVA=1 and configure a local Whisper model in the backend.
error.ocupada: The assistant is handling another request. Try again in a few seconds.
error.grande: The audio is too long. Ask a shorter question.
error.noEntendi: The audio could not be understood. Try again.
error.tiempo: Processing took too long. Check that the local voice service is running and try again.
error.general: The assistant could not answer right now.
